description: Cloud-Based Data Centre with Predictive Machine Learning Server Traces is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Niladri Dey, Gunasekhar T (KL University). Cloud Computing is been the field for interest by the research community and application development industry for few decades now. The ease of development, deployment and management of applications from wide range of computing paradigm and ability to manage the applications over network enabled systems are the biggest selling points of cloud computing. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
